context: 763a showed that 762a failed because the level-marginal CRPS term was a large extra objective component, not because proper level scoring is intrinsically invalid.
constraints: avoid post-hoc calibration as the base learned-law claim
avoid stacking unnormalized scalar proper scores
do not switch backend or add readout/source-scale knobs without new evidence
keep the candidate compatible with iv_only, anchor_only, and joint scopes

options.name: budget_matched_level_score_replacement
options.description: Replace the raw channel-level energy term with standardized level-delta marginal CRPS using a weight derived from the incumbent level-score budget, instead of adding it as a new large term.
cons: still uses a scalar objective budget
may under-correct validation hard-cell level allocation
may repeat the 691a standardized-delta weakness if the problem is not objective scale

options.name: self_normalized_multi_score_objective
options.description: Normalize each proper-score component by a detached batch or running scale so scalar weights are dimensionless.
pros: more principled than raw additive score magnitudes
cons: harder to interpret than the budget-matched replacement falsifier

options.name: conditional_source_scale_or_new_readout
options.description: Reopen conditional source-scale or readout expressiveness changes.
cons: already falsified as simple variants in 678a, 689a, 692b, and 702b/c
risks adding knobs before objective scale is resolved

recommended_next_experiment.hypothesis: If 762a failed mainly because the added level CRPS was over-weighted relative to the existing level objective budget, then replacing the raw channel-level energy with a budget-matched standardized level-CRPS term should preserve 755a train-tail robustness while testing whether the proper level score helps validation allocation.
recommended_next_experiment.weight_derivation: 0.007 approximates the incumbent validation channel-level-energy contribution: 0.05 * 0.275 / 1.970 = 0.00698 from 762a/763a.
recommended_next_experiment.falsifier: Reject if train-tail remains below 755a by more than one suite or validation coverage/level KS remains worse than 755a.

decision: Run the budget-matched replacement before any new architecture/backend/source-scale change.
